assertions.assertion: Every view and mutation comes from Product Core through one narrow BFF seam.
Read and write requests reach Product Core only after a request-bound real C06 MANAGE decision.
Nine management views use closed operation-specific item fields and non-empty evidence.
Seven management writes require version, idempotency, candidate hash and a request-bound, unexpired, single-use trusted confirmation consumption; a caller-computed hash alone is rejected.
Audit is read-only and every committed mutation must return a C18-namespaced audit reference; existence, Tenant ownership and immutability are reverified in the G1 C18 integration.
Private sessions and private memories are absent from the operation catalog and fail closed.
The thin shell displays only server-returned allowed actions and has no Core or authorization bypass.
Runtime source has no direct model, RAG, Connector, network, database or enterprise-data path.
